name: code4food-factory
description: The skillset a Factory window loads, plus the attended-side factory skills (spec interview, setup wizard). Unattended sessions with no human in the room: how to pick a backlog task, implement it, verify it headlessly, and review it before the PR. The driver, prompts, and schedulers ship in this plugin's factory/ tree and run from a per-machine runtime clone (see FACTORY.md).
